title: No Charge After the Hold Ends — Hospital Closing Charge
content:
Under **Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations**, the hospital closing charge never bills a day after the hold has ended. No day after the hold ended is charged: where the resident returned, the entry's days dated after the return date; where the bed was released, the entry's days dated after the release date, the day of release being the last held day; where the hold expired because the hospital discharged the resident to another setting, the entry's days dated after the hold's last held day; where the hold ended after the entry's last day, or has not ended, none.

The dates are those the reservation records: the return date, the release date, or, for an expiry, the hold's last held day and the expiry reason. The days not charged on this account are the hospital closing entry's last days.

**Hypothetical cases** (an entry from the 1st through the 25th, no day reversed): a release dated the 18th leaves the 19th through the 25th, 7 days, uncharged; a return dated the 12th leaves the 13th through the 25th, 13 days, uncharged; a hospital discharge to another setting with the hold's last held day on the 10th leaves the 11th through the 25th, 15 days, uncharged; a release dated the 25th or later leaves none. The days so left uncharged are never more than the entry's days.
